propositions: Infrastructure exceptions at gates must emit additive `gate_error_v1` sidecar records with `verdict=ERROR` and `error{cause,evidence_ref}` to initiate diagnosis intervals without changing the gate's pre-existing outcome.

Plan-review and code-review gates catch `LLMUnavailableError`, emit the ERROR record, and return existing degraded INDETERMINATE verdicts; completion gate wraps preflight to emit the ERROR record then re-raise, preserving fail-closed behavior.
The `gate_error_v1` schema is separate from verdict schemas and never routes through `reconcile_verdict`, ensuring the ERROR verdict is not coerced to FAIL and existing readers schema-guard it away.
Domain BLOCK/FAIL exceptions produce no ERROR record; only infra-path failures are captured.
